QuestInfo.name: The Story of Axes
QuestInfo.0: Deep in the #m222010002# of the Black Mountain, I heard #p2071010# is concerned about something. I better go check it out myself.
QuestInfo.1: I met #b#p2071010##k, who was heavily sighing at #m222010002# with a big lump on his head. Apparently, he got hurt from a random axe that was thrown on his way. After throwing the axe out of the pond in disgust, the owner of the axe, #b#p2071011##k, came and asked for the axe. He requested that anyone that finds the #b#t4031315##k return it to #p2071011#.\nThe Mountain God believes that the steel axe for the tree cutter might be taken by a monster, and that he has offered to look into the axe and see if it's legit. The axes will be available through #rDark Axe Stumps#k, and he'll look into it and see if it's really #b#t4031315##k.
QuestInfo.2: Through the request from #p2071010#, who I met at #m222010002# of the Black Mountain, I returned #t4031315# to its rightful owner, and received the storybook on 'The Story of the Axes'.

0.0: 아야야... 이거 참 산신령 체면이 말이아니군.\r\n#L0#  #b어쩌다가 머리에 혹이 생기셨어요?
0.1: 몇 일 전에 연못 속으로 떨어진 도끼에 머리를 부딪히고 말았네. 너무 화가 나서 도끼를 다시 연못 밖으로 집어 던져버렸지. 그런데 조금 전에 한 나뭇꾼이 와서 자신이 잃어버린 도끼를 내놓으라고 큰 소리를 치지 뭔가. 어찌나 고집불통이던지 내가 금도끼랑 은도끼를 준다고 해도 싫다더군.\r\n#L0# #b그래서 어떻게 하기로 하셨어요?
0.2: 잃어버린 도끼를 내가 찾아주기로 약속했는데 아무리 찾아봐도 없어. 요즘 이 근처에 도끼를 머리에 꽂고 다니는 몬스터들이 있던데, 혹시 그 놈들 중 한 마리가 가져간게 아닐까? 자네 날 좀 도와주지 않겠나?

0.0: Ouch... This is not the way the #p2071010# works.\r\n#L0# #bHow did you end up with that lump on your head?
0.1: A few days ago, I got hit on the head by an axe that was dropped inside the pond. I was so incensed by this unruly behavior that I threw it back out. Just now, some tree cutter came by and demanded that I return his lost axe, though. He was so adamant about his axe that he didn't want the gold axe or the silver axe that I offered in place of it.\r\n#L0# #bSo what do you plan on doing with it?
0.2: I promised to find the lost axe a while ago, but no matter how much I try, I can't find it. Nowadays, there seems to be monsters that have the axe stuck on their forehead. I wonder if one of them took his axe... Can you please help me?

yes.0: Please find the #bTree Cutter's Steel Axe#k and return it to the Tree Cutter. I think a monster might have snatched it. Bring the #baxe#k that the #rDark Stump#k drops, and I'll determine if it belongs to the Tree Cutter.

no.0: For you to say no to #p2071010#'s request... my gosh, the lump on my head seems to be getting bigger and bigger now...

1.0: Hey, that axe you have in your hand... it looks awfully familiar. It looks like the one I lost! Can I take a look at it?
1.1: Yes! This is the axe that I lost! I was working, and all of a sudden, it slipped out of my hand and fell into the pond. Too bad the God of Mountain decided to throw it back out somewhere remote. I returned home with a promise that he'll someday find it for me, but that really wasn't enough to comfort me... anyway, thank you so much for your work.
1.2: Here, take it. It's a book that I've had for a long time, but I really don't have time to read books these days, so it's been doing nothing but collecting dust. I want to give this to you in return for bringing back the axe!

yes.0: I haven't been able to concentrate on work with my axe gone. I'm so glad I got it back!

npc.0: If you happened to find the steel axe that belongs to the tree cutter, please return it to him.

item.0: Where did my axe go? I can't work without the axe that my hand has grown accustomed to...
